method: Reviewed the lesson and metadata against current OpenAI and Anthropic API documentation and RFC 9110; extended the deterministic local admission/retry model; executed its unittest suite and offline boundary assertions. No provider requests were made.

observations.trace: Added queue-wait vs task-deadline decisions and validation for invalid capacities and non-finite values; negative Retry-After is rejected rather than treated as missing; ambiguous connection failures are not replayed unless the caller explicitly establishes replay safety. Clarified HTTP-date and seconds forms, provider-specific error semantics, maxAttempts counting, SDK retry ownership, and production/runtime limitations.

limitations: No live provider, SDK behavior, HTTP header parser, distributed queue, atomic quota store, or production scheduler was tested.
The helper consumes already-parsed delay seconds and caller-supplied queue/budget snapshots; it does not implement an RFC Retry-After parser or concurrency control.
Documentation may change; provider, endpoint, and installed SDK versions must be rechecked before deployment.
